verdict.rationale: Gemini API ships agent-oriented docs. There is a dedicated coding-agents page, Gemini API Skills that inject docs and best practices into an assistant's context, a public Gemini Docs MCP server for live doc search, and a docs index at aistudio.google.com/llms.txt. The probe 404 at ai.google.dev/llms.txt covers a different domain, so it does not contradict the aistudio index. missing for 10: an llms.txt on the main ai.google.dev docs domain, independent hands-on confirmation that agents can consume these docs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The docs index (aistudio.google.com/llms.txt) lists it as "Gemini Docs MCP server ... Model Context Protocol server providing live documentation search"
gives your agent live access to the entire documentation site.
install the [Gemini API development skill](/gemini-api/docs/coding-agents) to give your agent access to the latest documentation and best practices.
Loading these skills injects the correct patterns and guidelines directly into your AI assistant's context.
